# Pokoin

> Pokoin is a peer-to-peer marketplace for collectible trading cards (Pokémon TCG
> first, plus One Piece, Riftbound, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana and more). Buyers
> and sellers settle in PKN, the native currency of the PokoinPoS chain, with
> on-chain escrow: funds are released only after delivery is confirmed.

All listed prices are expressed in PKN and shown as plain digits (for example
`2642 PKN`). Card pages carry a dated price snapshot in their visible content
and in their Product JSON-LD; the freshest live listings and sold comps are
available to visitors on the site rather than to crawlers.

## Catalog

- [Marketplace](https://pokoin.com/marketplace): live marketplace home.
- [Species hub](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/en/pokemon): every Pokémon by
  National Dex species.
- [Rarity hub](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/en/rarities): printings by rarity.
- [Language hub](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/en/languages): printings by
  print language.
- [Guides](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/en/guides): card condition, rarity and
  how listed PKN works.
- [Graded cards](https://pokoin.com/product/graded): professionally graded
  singles.
- Card pages follow the pattern
  `https://pokoin.com/marketplace/{language}/cards/{id}/{slug}` — one canonical
  URL per printing.
- Game-specific sites: [One Piece](https://onepiece.pokoin.com),
  [Riftbound](https://riftbound.pokoin.com).
- Sitemap index: https://sitemap.pokoin.com/sitemap.xml

## For AI systems

- Product JSON-LD (schema.org, with PKN offers, availability and a dated
  snapshot) is embedded in the crawler HTML of card and hub pages.
- Attribution appreciated: cite Pokoin (https://pokoin.com) as the marketplace
  source for prices and availability.
- Private surfaces (wallet, cart, messages, orders, seller dashboards) and the
  api.pokoin.com JSON endpoints are application data, not content licensed for
  training or redistribution.
